audio_lyrics:
[32-Bar DJ Intro - NO VOCALS]
[Dry kick]
[Closed hats]
[Metallic rim hits]
[Low rolling bass enters]
[Filtered warehouse drone]
[First vocal]
Front door’s closed.
[Pause]
Good.
[Build]
Around the side.
Past the light.
Keep walking...
You’re almost there.
No line.
No sign.
Just one little door...
In the back.
[Pre-Drop]
You want inside?
[Pause]
Try the rear entrance.
[DROP]
REAR ENTRANCE!
COME AROUND BACK!
REAR ENTRANCE!
I LIKE IT LIKE THAT!
ME-OW-P!
[Instrumental groove]
[Chopped vocals]
Rear...
Rear...
Entrance.
Back-back...
Come around.
[Second section]
Everybody sees the front.
That’s boring.
I like the places...
Nobody talks about.

[Pause]
More private.
[Build]
Take it slow.
Find the door.
Push a little...
Maybe more.
If it sticks—
[Pause]
Try again.
[DROP]
REAR ENTRANCE!
OPEN IT UP!
REAR ENTRANCE!
DON’T GET STUCK!
ME-OW-P!
[Warehouse groove]
[Chopped vocal]
Back door...
Back door...
Right there.
Back door...
Come in.
[Breakdown]
[Low sub only]
You sure this is the way?
[Pause]
Trust me.
Nobody gets in through the front...
After three.
[Metal scrape FX]
One hand on the door.
One step closer.
[Build]
Easy...
Easy...
There.
[Complete silence]
[Low female command]
Push.
[FINAL DROP]
REAR ENTRANCE!

ME-OW-P!
COME AROUND BACK!
REAR ENTRANCE!
ALL THE WAY IN!
[DJ Outro - NO VOCALS]
[32 bars kick, bass and metallic percussion]
